title: a question's key is recomputed from its detail by a migration, not a branch of the plan
line: tools/initdb.py --migrate recomputes every research_question row's key from its own detail_json with plan.q_key, open and closed rows alike, so a row written under an older, truncating key is found under its full key without the plan itself carrying a re-key branch

steps.say: the 1940 page arrives; the son and mother accepted first, so the father's own card can be
the father accepted: his birthplace disagrees with the file's own claim, a conflict whose detail is well over 120 characters

steps.say: the plan opens the conflict at its full, untruncated key

expect.why: one row, open, at whatever key this run gave it

steps.say: the owner dismisses it, and the catalog is put back as an older catalog would hold it: the same row, under a truncated key an older q_key once wrote, closed and dismissed

steps.say: the migration recomputes every row's key from its own detail_json
